normalization: rolling prior 60 IS trading days, same 5m time bucket
f1_entry: signal bar completes -> ETF open 1 bar(s) later
f2_entry_condition: previous FUT bar volume > same-bucket rolling median AND abs(C-O) <= same-bucket rolling median; current FUT close > previous FUT close; then ETF open 1 bar(s) later
positioning: long/flat, fixed notional, one position at a time per scenario, no pyramiding
execution_limitations: minute OHLCV only; no historical bid/ask spread
ETF open is used as boundary execution reference plus adverse slippage
